findings.claim: Making .d-header .contents a flex container (floats removed) breaks long-title handling in the docked desktop header: the extra-info flex item keeps min-width:auto / default flex-shrink, so a long nowrap .topic-link no longer ellipsizes and either squeezes .panel until its floated icons wrap inside the fixed 60px header, or pushes .panel past the right edge (IE10 -ms-flex 0 0 auto).
findings.evidence: Reasoned, not rendered (headless Chromium blocked by sandbox in both seats). .topic-link is white-space:nowrap (desktop/topic-post.scss:518-538); header-extra-info component renders an untagged ember-view wrapping .extra-info-wrapper (components/header-extra-info.js.es6, templates/components/header-extra-info.hbs:1); previously floats + overflow:hidden on .extra-info-wrapper bounded the title. Seats differ on exact mechanism (which element is the flex item; overflow vs squeeze) but agree on the regression. Repro page left in OCR seat scratchpad (hdr.html).
findings.reason: Correctness regression on every desktop topic with a long title once the header docks; two correctness seats independently. Suggested fix: min-width:0 + flex:1 1 auto on the actual flex item (give header-extra-info a class), or flex-shrink:0 on .title/.panel. Needs a red repro (rendered layout check) before fixing.

findings.claim: Replacing .small-action-desc padding 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em with 0 1.5% leaves the untouched mobile override .small-action .custom-message { margin-left: -40px } pulling the custom message ~40px left over the now-adjacent .topic-avatar icon.
findings.evidence: Reasoned. mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522 offset was sized for the old 4em left padding with a floated avatar; patch does not touch the mobile stylesheet.
findings.reason: Visible overlap on mobile small-action posts with custom messages. Raised Important by superpowers, Minor by OCR, noted out-of-scope by ponytail and mattpocock; normalised to Important. Fix with the patch (drop/retune the -40px offset).

findings.claim: .small-action is now a flex container and .small-action-desc a flex item without flex-grow, so it shrink-wraps its text; the float:right edit/delete buttons inside it (topic-post.scss:309) now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge of the row.
findings.evidence: Reasoned. Buttons are children of .small-action-desc per templates/components/small-action.hbs:3-8; row is 755px on desktop (desktop/topic-post.scss:730). Superpowers rated Important, OCR Minor.
findings.reason: Visible desktop layout regression for staff controls; one-line fix (flex:1 on .small-action-desc). Normalised to Important.

findings.claim: -ms-align-items is not a real CSS property in any IE/Edge version; IE10 uses -ms-flex-align (already on line 120). Dead output.
findings.reason: Trivial deletion; all four seats agree.

findings.evidence: grep -nE ' +$' app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss prints line 120; breaches CONTRIBUTING.md coding conventions and .editorconfig trim_trailing_whitespace.

findings.claim: align-items:$alignment; lacks a space after the colon.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md coding conventions require spaces after colons; every other declaration in the patch has one.
findings.reason: Documented-standard breach, trivial. (superpowers seat explicitly declined to judge formatting.)

findings.claim: align-items mixin body indented 4 spaces while the other new mixins use 2.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md 'two spaces' and .editorconfig indent_size=2; mitigated by pre-existing clearfix mixin (lines 38-47) also using 4.
findings.reason: Documented-standard breach in new code, trivial.

findings.claim: 'All prefixes' is incomplete: align-items() emits no -moz-box-align although flexbox() emits display:-moz-box, so old-box-model Firefox stretches instead of centring.
findings.reason: ponytail: Firefox 16-19 -moz-box era is marginal; add only if those browsers are actually still supported (README.md:40-47 lists Firefox 16+).

findings.claim: Mixins pass values straight through to legacy properties: -webkit-box-align/-ms-flex-align need start/end not flex-start/flex-end, and -webkit-box-ordinal-group must be >=1, so future align-items(flex-start) or order(0) calls emit invalid legacy CSS.
findings.evidence: Reasoned; current callers (center, baseline, 2, 3) are valid.
findings.reason: ponytail: no current caller is affected; do not add value-mapping logic for speculative calls.

findings.claim: In the 2009 display:-webkit-box model (Safari 5.1, Android <=4.3, iOS <=6) auto margins are not honoured, so margin-left:auto on .panel no longer right-aligns it, and the float:right fallback was removed.
findings.evidence: Reasoned; README.md:40-47 lists Safari 5.1 / Android 4.1 as supported.
findings.reason: ponytail: low-impact legacy-browser issue; settle with a real-device check on a -webkit-box-only browser before acting.

findings.claim: @include order(2) on .extra-info-wrapper is ineffective/redundant: .extra-info-wrapper is not itself a flex item (it sits inside the header-extra-info ember-view), and visual order comes out right solely because .panel has order(3).
findings.reason: ponytail: dead declaration; remove when touching the header fix for the long-title finding.

findings.claim: The order mixin and both order() calls could be replaced by moving the header-extra-info block above .panel in header.hbs; CSS reordering also makes Tab order differ from visual order.
findings.reason: ponytail: advisory simplification touching the template; not blocking.

findings.claim: .small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px } (added in the base commit for float layout) now shifts the clock icon 5px above centre under align-items:center.
findings.reason: ponytail: 5px cosmetic offset; verify on mobile render then drop the override.

findings.claim: Scope creep: commit message says 'adding flexbox to header' but the patch also re-lays out .small-action (post-stream action rows) and rewrites its spacing, contrary to CONTRIBUTING.md one-feature-per-branch.
findings.evidence: Diff hunk topic-post.scss:263-303 vs commit message; CONTRIBUTING.md section on branches.
findings.reason: Advisory seat; no spec exists, commit message is not a spec. The concrete regressions this hunk causes are tracked as separate fix findings; splitting the commit is a process call for the author.

findings.claim: float:left on .small-action .topic-avatar is now dead because floats are ignored on flex items.
findings.evidence: CSS flex spec: float has no effect on flex items.

findings.claim: Mobile override .small-action-desc p { padding-top: 0 } is now dead since the patch removed the base p { padding-top: 4px } it cancelled.
findings.evidence: Base rule removed in topic-post.scss hunk; override at mobile/topic-post.scss:516-519.

findings.claim: clearfix on .contents is now dead weight; its ::before/::after (display:table) become empty flex items, a trap if justify-content:space-between is added later.
findings.evidence: foundation/helpers.scss:53-62. OCR seat assessed it as harmless today.
findings.reason: ponytail: harmless today (seats agree on zero-width); remove the class when convenient.

findings.claim: Commit 5b229316ee message is a summary line only, no body, while it also changes small-action spacing and badge margins.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md commit section asks for a blank line and detailed description.
findings.reason: Commit metadata, not code; address when the commit is reworded/split.

findings.claim: Third-party themes/plugins relying on .d-header .title {float:left} / .panel {float:right} or adding floated children to .contents will change layout because floats are ignored in a flex container.
findings.reason: ponytail: unverified ecosystem risk; settle by checking popular themes before release.
